page.overview:
Who is Bumblebee's Wings?

Bumblebee's Wings is an Epic unreleased Back Bling in Fortnite: Battle Royale, that can be purchased in the Item Shop with the Transformers Pack for $24.99. Bumblebee's Wings was first released in Chapter 4: Season 4 and is part of the Transformers Set. Category:Collaborations Category:Bumblebee media Category:Autobots
